mapper.insert:
insert into gc_access(id,master_id,role_type,admin_id,code,group_name,subject_json,must_subject_json,may_subject_json,update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id},#{item.masterId},#{item.roleType},#{item.adminId},#{item.code}, #{item.groupName}, #{item.subjectJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{item.mustSubjectJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{item.maySubjectJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, now())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE master_id = values(master_id), role_type = values(role_type), admin_id = values(admin_id), code = values(code), subject_json = values(subject_json), group_name = values(group_name), must_subject_json = values(must_subject_json), may_subject_json = values(may_subject_json), create_time = now()

insert into gc_access(id,master_id,role_type,admin_id,code,group_name,channel_json,subscribe_json,subject_json,update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id},#{item.masterId},#{item.roleType},#{item.adminId},#{item.code}, #{item.groupName}, #{item.channelJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{item.subscribeJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{item.subjectJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, now())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE master_id = values(master_id), role_type = values(role_type), admin_id = values(admin_id), code = values(code), subject_json = values(subject_json), group_name = values(group_name), channel_json = values(channel_json), subscribe_json = values(subscribe_json), create_time = now()
mapper.select: select COUNT(if(role_type=0,TRUE,NULL)) as adminNum, COUNT(if(role_type=1,TRUE,NULL)) as userNum, COUNT(if(code_type=1,TRUE,NULL)) as subjectAdminNum FROM gc_access WHERE master_id=#{masterId}
mapper.sql: a.id, a.master_id, a.role_type, a.admin_id, a.code, a.subject_json, a.update_time, a.create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM gc_access a where master_id=#{masterId} and json_contains(subject_json,CONCAT('',#{subjectId},''))

SELECT a.*,s.id as img_id, s.name as img_name, s.file_url as img_file_url, s.save_type as img_save_type, s.file_type_index as img_file_type_index,s.file_type as fileType FROM gc_access a left join sys_file s on s.id = a.package_img_id where a.package_name is not null and a.master_id=#{masterId} order by a.order
select * from gc_access where 1=1 and master_id = #{masterId} and JSON_CONTAINS(subject_json, CONVERT(#{id}, CHAR)) = 1
select * from gc_access where 1=1 and master_id = #{masterId} and (JSON_CONTAINS(channel_json, CONVERT(#{id}, CHAR)) = 1 or JSON_CONTAINS(subscribe_json, CONVERT(#{id}, CHAR)) = 1 )
select * from gc_access where 1=1 and master_id = #{masterId} and (JSON_CONTAINS(subject_json, #{subId}) or JSON_CONTAINS(must_subject_json,#{subId}) or JSON_CONTAINS(may_subject_json,#{subId}))

SELECT ifnull(JSON_LENGTH(ac.may_subject_json),0)+ifnull(JSON_LENGTH(ac.must_subject_json),0) as subjectNum, ac.* FROM gc_access ac LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua ON ac.id = ua.access_id AND ua.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ac.master_id = #{masterId} AND ac.group_name IS NOT NULL AND ua.user_id = #{userId} and (JSON_CONTAINS(ua.role_json,'"groupMember"') = 1 or JSON_CONTAINS(ua.role_json,'"groupAdmin"') = 1)
and concat('%',#{name},'%')
order by ac.group_name asc
